dedupe_keys.name: rana formerly 3di 1d 2d hydrodynamic flood and water management modelling platform

description: Rana, formerly 3Di, is a commercial hydrodynamic modelling platform for flood and water management analysis, combining a simulation core with project-based data management and collaboration. The 3Di name has fully transitioned into Rana, according to the release notes, and the old 3diwatermanagement.com address now redirects to the Rana site; the register lists it under the Dutch firm Nelen & Schuurmans. Coverage: a general modelling tool, with a Dutch-language site and map catalogues of Dutch land cover, land use and AHN elevation; models combine 2D surface water, 2D groundwater and a 1D network in one grid solved in a single matrix, on a structured staggered grid of square cells with local refinement, with rain, laterals, breaches, infiltration, interception, control structures and substance transport for water quality. Format and access: a cloud web platform, a desktop client, Rana Live for interactive sessions, a scenario archive, an API for the hydrodynamic core, and the Python package threedigrid for reading results; licences and demos are requested from the vendor, and prices were not published on the pages read. Licence: proprietary commercial licence. Caveats: most technical pages were read from the documentation site, not verified in use, and the switch from 3Di to Rana means older 3Di references and tools may point to renamed services. Simulation uses: pluvial and fluvial flood simulation, dike breach scenarios and drainage capacity studies for hazard exposure, capacity planning, emergency response and climate adaptation. Related records: SOBEK (platform-sobek), Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm) and HEC-RAS (model-hec-ras) are comparable hydrodynamic modelling tools.
